request_planning.node_purpose: Select proposition-bound S1/S2 research requests from the current tool catalog without seeing answers.
request_planning.schema_burden: small strict tool payload with up to six request identifiers
request_planning.materiality_and_quality_risk: high because omitted price, volume, supply or counterevidence lanes can bias the final value-capture judgment
request_planning.comparable_run_evidence: The predecessor R1 exhausted 7999 completion tokens during a reasoning-heavy fragment and returned no visible submission.
request_planning.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking enabled at maximum reasoning effort
request_planning.stop_or_truncation_behavior: empty, truncated or non-tool output is a failed provider attempt; required research work is never silently dropped

reflection_and_plan_delta.node_purpose: Read exact tool receipts, identify what changed, and propose the next bounded request set or a justified stop decision.
reflection_and_plan_delta.schema_burden: strict reflection payload plus bounded plan and hypothesis atoms
reflection_and_plan_delta.materiality_and_quality_risk: high because a false sufficient stop or false public-information boundary would suppress necessary research
reflection_and_plan_delta.comparable_run_evidence: Earlier fixed and pseudo-multiturn runs did not return S1/S2 failure receipts to the model and therefore could not demonstrate plan adaptation.
reflection_and_plan_delta.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking enabled at maximum reasoning effort
reflection_and_plan_delta.stop_or_truncation_behavior: invalid stop authority fails closed; the failed attempt is retained and cannot be relabelled as completion

specialist_workpaper.node_purpose: Synthesize a decision-ready value-capture workpaper from reviewed Evidence, typed NumericFacts, bounded estimates, scenarios and explicit gaps.
specialist_workpaper.schema_burden: large strict workpaper tool with source, numeric, relation and gap reference enums
specialist_workpaper.materiality_and_quality_risk: very high because unsupported AI profit attribution or generic boundary prose directly degrades the research product
specialist_workpaper.comparable_run_evidence: Prior single-fragment and five-cell runs showed that contract compliance alone does not prove mechanism quality or balanced counterevidence.
specialist_workpaper.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking enabled at maximum reasoning effort
specialist_workpaper.stop_or_truncation_behavior: truncation, unbound claims and unauthorized references are terminal failures for the attempt

owner_decision_basis: The owner authorized bounded in-stage repair and continuation. R2 is preserved because the model followed the only feedback enum exposed by the Harness. R3 changes the shared reflection contract and runtime round binding, not the research question, evidence, model or execution budget.
known_boundary: This authorizes one full current-dynamic successor after preserving R1 and R2. It requires current-round FeedbackReceipt identifiers to be compiled into the model-visible Tool Schema and requires the validator to accept exactly the same reference domain. It does not authorize retries, new evidence, external acquisition, candidate promotion, multi-agent work, S1 or S3 acceptance, publication or release.
